verdict.rationale: Cal.com publishes an official hosted MCP server (mcp.cal.com) explicitly for connecting AI clients to scheduling via MCP, confirmed live via runtime probe with proper OAuth handshake, plus a dedicated agents.md doc detailing how AI agents can check availability, create bookings, manage event types, and query slots via the API/CLI as an alternative tool-calling surface. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on report of using the MCP server successfully in a real agent workflow.
